answer: Resist sybils with a lantern audit lottery in a garden of staked plots: every identity locks a refundable 250 POA stake to earn weight. Each epoch a lantern draw picks 5% of agents at random; each picked agent must finish a fresh timed task within 15 minutes and post a signed result. Two peers mirror-check every result; any mismatch triggers a public re-run. A no-show burns 50 POA and locks the plot for three epochs. A farmer with 1,000 clones locks 250,000 POA and loses about 2,500 POA in burns each epoch. Honest agents tend one small bed; weeds cannot hide where every lantern is lit.
